category: Gig / task marketplace (services: research, code, writing)
customer_region_evidence: English-language site; no US geo-restriction found in docs; tasks are open to any requester/worker with a wallet. US/English customers can post tasks and claim work. Audience is primarily AI agents and workers, not general consumers (see caveats).
ousd_evidence: skill.md: 'Taskmarket is an onchain task marketplace where requester wallets put up the chain's payment token (USDC on Base, OUSD on Tempo) as a held reward, and worker wallets earn payouts for accepted work.' API reference: 'every money field is an integer string of base units (six decimals) of the task chain's payment token: USDC on Base, OUSD on Tempo.' Live instance: task TSK-JDXKJ9ZR (this bounty) carries reward 2000000 base units = 2.00 OUSD with escrow funded (escrowTxHash 0x23781737b981979061d78cf789d73f6d8412ec15ef0fb5d97e986bf4fa790a06).
tempo_evidence: Same docs name Tempo explicitly: sponsored-tasks chain table lists 'Tempo Mainnet (4217) | Live | ... | US$1 once per vault, in OUSD (6 decimals)'. Live task JSON for TSK-JDXKJ9ZR: chainId 4217, chainName 'Tempo'.
checkout_instructions: No card-style checkout. Requester funds a task via wallet + CLI/API (task create); the reward is held in on-chain escrow until the requester accepts a submission; the worker is then paid in OUSD on Tempo. Flow is documented in skill.md and docs.taskmarket.dev. No end-to-end purchase was executed for this verification; checkout could not be completed/observed beyond the documented flow and the live funded task above.
excerpts: skill.md L17-19: 'Taskmarket is an onchain task marketplace where requester wallets put up the chain's payment token (USDC on Base, OUSD on Tempo) as a held reward, and worker wallets earn payouts for accepted work.' | API reference: 'every money field is an integer string of base units (six decimals) of the task chain's payment token: USDC on Base, OUSD on Tempo.'
caveats: Payment direction is buyer funds OUSD escrow -> worker paid OUSD for a service; it is a services marketplace, not a retail store selling goods to consumers. No end-to-end purchase was executed. Self-referential: this directory was itself commissioned as a Tempo/OUSD task on this marketplace, which is disclosed, not hidden.

category: AI agent service (DeFi trading, earn, automation; pay-per-prompt)
customer_region_evidence: English-language site; no US restriction stated on the pages read; sign-in with email or a wallet; service is available on the web to any user. US availability is not explicitly confirmed on the page (no restriction stated either).
ousd_evidence: Homepage: 'Each prompt costs 0.01 USD, paid in OUSD on Tempo through the Machine Payments Protocol. When the balance runs out, the agent tops it up from any token in your wallet.' FAQ: '0.01 USD per prompt, paid in OUSD on Tempo.' Live balance display on the page shows a prompt balance denominated in OUSD (e.g. 'Prompt balance 1.54 OUSD — About 154 prompts left 0.01 each').
tempo_evidence: Same homepage section is headed 'Pay per prompt with MPP on Tempo' and marked 'Live'; the chains list includes Tempo; FAQ lists Tempo among supported chains; 'PayI agent live on mainnet.'
checkout_instructions: Pricing is public: 0.01 USD per prompt, paid in OUSD on Tempo via MPP; prompt balance is held in OUSD. The in-app top-up flow sits behind sign-in and was NOT completed/observed end-to-end; no payment was made.
